capabilities: Insert dialogue, monologue, narration, direction and cast-change blocks
Pick the speaking character from a fuzzy search picker
Color-code dialogue and monologue blocks per character
Show character avatar images beside blocks in reading view
Edit or delete blocks from hover actions
extras: Author states it is a work in progress that may change or break. Characters are discovered from notes carrying a configurable tag; avatars come from a tat-avatar- embed or a note property, and the avatar property is off by default on installs that predate it.
motivation: The author needed to organize dialogue for a game they are working on without inserting special characters and complicated combinations, and wanted shortcut-driven writing with modals for sections that need more configuration.
problem: Writing dialogue and scene direction in Markdown means fiddly manual formatting and special characters, and speakers are hard to tell apart at a glance.

relations.evidence: handy when another plugin manages the image, like Make-a-Wiki

summary: Storytelling toolkit that inserts callout-based dialogue, monologue, narration, direction and cast-change blocks with per-character colors and avatars.
